note: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py with the same severity (extraction/verify_all.py GRAPH_AGREEMENT checks ids, severities and the ONE_HERO exception list against the validator).

rules.rule: The PageSpec's node sequence (section#variant) must match its DECLARED template's node list (required/repeatable/minCount/maxCount/variants; reference-only nodes are dropped in generated mode; referenceMinCount lowers a minimum in reference mode). The template id is cross-referenced, never nodes[] in isolation.
template.not-built-fallback (the router catch-all) is documentation of a state, not a page: a PageSpec may not declare it, in either mode.
shell.header opens the page and shell.footer closes the in-flow content; only overlays may sit between the last section and the footer.
Exactly one HERO node per page, except hero-less templates (the video detail page, which opens directly into the player, and the fallback).
The hero is the first non-shell node: nothing precedes it.
A section may not appear more often than its contract's maxPerPage (max observed on any route).
Two adjacent nodes may not have the same section AND variant, except variants a contract lists in consecutiveVariants (alternating rows legitimately repeat).
Overlay nodes (fixed panels) take no page height and may be followed only by other overlays or the footer; no in-flow content follows an overlay.
template.home is valid only on '/', and '/' only on template.home.
A reference-mode PageSpec's route must be a served route mapped to the same template in templates/routes.json.
Nodes whose template entry lists modes [reference] (the clone-only read-the-original link) are valid only in reference mode.
A node's retrievalEligible flag (if set) must equal the value pinned in code for its section.
The scheme-coloured sections of one page (split hero, study preview, quote card, call-to-action band) must all carry the same scheme variant: the page colour scheme is chosen once.
No more than 3 sections with autoplaying motion (marquee, auto-fading carousel, looping video, looping timeline) on one page; the busiest served page (the homepage) has 3.
